integrity: The analytic sign-arrangement proof establishes the universal claim; the independent direct-semantics checker tests every integer Venn quadruple of total size at most 12 and all 64 atoms. No independent validation or historical-priority audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Named two-noun fragment, finite nonempty universes, and 64 atomic sentences only. This is neither an arbitrary-noun theorem nor a count modulo noun renaming. The complete text of Moss (2016) was not inspected, so historical priority remains conditional.
title: The 67 complete two-noun cardinality-syllogistic types and a sharp seven-element bound
